invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Pair value.
The stream of HoodieClusteringGroup (left field) in the result Pair should not be null as per contract of buildClusteringGroupsForPartition.
The right field of the result Pair (Boolean) should not be null per typical usage.
partitionPath parameter should never be null.
The input list of file slices should always be non-null.
